notes: DeepSeek V4 / V4.1 Flash measurements the model is checked against. kind a64fx_*: gemm a64fx/ds41f runner on 12 nodes (fit: true rows set A64FX_CURRENT). kind decode/prefill: the gemm hetero/ds4f runner for V4-Flash on TR16 + RX 9070 XT (fit: false, cross-check only; that runner's own ceiling analysis says 12 tok/s). Tolerances are relative. kind v100_decode: the Strata runner on 2x Tesla V100 (ds41f.V100Hw; fit: true rows set its pass/token/expert constants, the Engram read rate is fit to the full-node IQ2_XXSE4 rows).
